title: 污水處理廠臭氣生物濾床
summary: 本課以「把污水臭氣收集、傳質、生物反應與床層維護串成完整流程」為主軸，依序處理臭味源與收集邊界、入口濃度與污染負荷、生物膜傳質與反應、消除容量與去除百分比、變動負荷與重新評估。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Connect wastewater odour collection, mass transfer, biodegradation and bed maintenance, progressing through Odour sources and collection boundary, Inlet concentration and contaminant loading, Biofilm mass transfer and reaction, Elimination capacity and percent removal, Variable loading and reassessment. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.title: 臭味源與收集邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Odour sources and collection boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 臭味源與收集邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Odour sources and collection boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在進水、污泥儲存與脫水區分別標記臭氣源，先確認是否有效收集再討論末端處理率。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。
steps.instructionEn: Mark odour sources at inlet works, sludge storage and dewatering and establish capture before interpreting downstream removal. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
steps.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「臭味源與收集邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Odour sources and collection boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「臭味源與收集邊界」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Odour sources and collection boundary, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 集氣管與抽風需求：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Collection ducts and blower demand: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 集氣管與抽風需求 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Collection ducts and blower demand and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 分開罩口、管路與床層壓降，風量過少可能漏收，過大則增加負荷與耗能。 風機軸功率近似流量乘壓升再除效率；阻力增加時不能假設風量與效率都不受影響。
steps.instructionEn: Separate hood, duct and bed pressure losses; low flow may lose capture while excessive flow adds load and energy. Fan shaft power is approximately flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency; increasing resistance may also change flow and efficiency.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：風量 Q=1.5 m³/s；壓升 Δp=1200 Pa；假設效率 η=0.60。公式 P=Q*dp/eta/1000，計算得 3 kW。適用邊界：不可壓縮、固定效率的比較，不是風機曲線選型。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Airflow Q=1.5 m³/s; pressure rise Δp=1200 Pa; assumed efficiency η=0.60. Formula P=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives 3 kW. Applicability: An incompressible fixed-efficiency comparison, not fan-curve selection.
steps.failure: 堵塞使壓降上升，若只提高風機轉速可能增加能耗而不解決配流。 在「集氣管與抽風需求」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Blockage raises pressure drop; speed increases may waste energy without correcting distribution. Mark where this error can enter the Collection ducts and blower demand flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「集氣管與抽風需求」，量測風量、差壓與輸入功率，在同一運轉點核對效率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。

steps.objective: 辨識 空床停留時間 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Empty-bed residence time and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先以總床體積計算 EBRT，再檢查氣體是否均勻穿床；它不等於每個分子的實際孔隙時間。 空床停留時間用總床體積與氣量定義，與實際孔隙停留時間不同。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate EBRT from total bed volume, then check flow distribution; it does not equal every molecule’s actual pore residence. Empty-bed residence time uses total bed volume and flow and differs from actual pore-gas residence.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：空床體積 V=60 m³；氣量 Q=3600 m³/h。公式 EBRT=V/Q*3600，計算得 60 s。適用邊界：平均氣流與固定床體積，不包含孔隙率、短流或反應動力學。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Empty-bed volume V=60 m³; gas flow Q=3600 m³/h. Formula EBRT=V/Q*3600 gives 60 s. Applicability: Mean gas flow and fixed bed volume without porosity, bypass or kinetics.

steps.check: 針對「空床停留時間」，量各分區氣量、壓降和水分，檢查是否有未利用床區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Empty-bed residence time, Measure zone flows, pressure drops and moisture to identify unused bed regions. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.instruction: 同時比較每床體積移除量與去除比例，判讀低濃度高去除率是否具有足夠負荷能力。 消除容量是每單位床體積每小時移除的質量，和百分比去除率回答不同問題。
steps.instructionEn: Compare removal per bed volume with percentage removal to assess whether high removal at low concentration demonstrates sufficient capacity. Elimination capacity is mass removed per bed volume per hour and answers a different question from percentage removal.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氣量 Q=1000 m³/h；入口 Cin=50 mg/m³；出口 Cout=10 mg/m³；床 V=20 m³。公式 EC=Q*(Cin-Cout)/V/1000，計算得 2 g/(m³ bed·h)。適用邊界：同一化合物與氣體基準、穩態；不能以單一化合物代表整體嗅覺反應。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gas Q=1000 m³/h; inlet Cin=50 mg/m³; outlet Cout=10 mg/m³; bed V=20 m³. steps.instruction: 用暴雨進水或污泥作業的假想尖峰改變負荷，檢查排放質量、床體反應與嗅覺評估是否一致。 消除容量是每單位床體積每小時移除的質量，和百分比去除率回答不同問題。
